conclusions.gpu_retinex: Hybrid pipeline: native CUDA/OpenCL Gaussian filters plus CPU expression/statistics stages.
conclusions.fast_cpu: Largest sigma replaced by frame mean; remaining blurs downsample for CPU fast mode.
conclusions.fast_gpu: Largest sigma replaced by frame mean; remaining Gaussian blurs retain full resolution.
conclusions.native_code: vszipcu/vszipcl GaussBlur uses separable finite Gaussian taps; project exact uses double recursive Gaussian.
